independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored nothing in the DG0 candidate, including tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, .github and .claude/agents. My only writes are this record and its findings, verifications and narrative sidecars, plus evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-26/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-26 review record. I read only my own earlier-round evidence, and I executed QA's earlier real-repo-gate-blockers.mjs harness in my own disposable clone. HEAD stayed at 2f480e4 throughout my run.

checks_run.actual: Anchor 1 is unconditional. The new branch 'if (!commitPresent(round.source_commit)) errors.push(... is not present; a closure must be verified against a retained candidate (F-DG0-169))' replaces the conditional skip, and the else-branch keeps the ancestry check. Anchor 2's guard (:750-752) still only compares when the head is well-formed and present, but checkInvocation (:388-405) has already hard-errored in every other case, so there is no bypass. checks_run.procedure: Reproduce my round-25 F-DG0-169 case, then show it fixed. Run the SEC24 + SEC25 + SEC26 fragments, appended to a disposable copy of validator.test.mjs, on --no-local clones of the round-25 baseline 2386a0f and the candidate 7edacdc.
checks_run.environment: two --no-local clones under $TMPDIR, removed afterwards; node --test
checks_run.expected: At 2386a0f, SEC26-1 (absent-source round, post-freeze fix) closes with 0 errors. At 7edacdc it is rejected by the anchor-1 'is not present' error, and every earlier guarantee still holds.
checks_run.actual: At 2386a0f, SEC25-3/SEC26-1 give 0 errors: reproduced. At 7edacdc, SEC26-1 gives 1 error, 'verified in round-2, whose frozen candidate source_commit deadbeefde is not present; a closure must be verified against a retained candidate (F-DG0-169)'. SEC26-2 (the old SEC24-2 control: a forged round with a real fix, verified in it) is now rejected by design, and its single error is the anchor-1 one. SEC26-3 (the absent-source round is not the verifying round; the finding is re-verified in a retained gate round) gives 0 errors, so the findManifest tolerance is intact and no genuine flow regressed. SEC26-4 (the committed test's fixture) is rejected by both anchor 1 and checkReviewRounds. SEC24-1/3/4/5/6 and SEC25-1/2/4 pass, so F-DG0-164/165/166/168/246/249 hold. On 7edacdc only SEC24-2 fails, and it asserted the pre-D-042 behaviour that D-042 intentionally removes. SEC26-5 was an observational probe whose fixture was invalid (it gated on the forged round, which gives candidate mismatches); it is not relied on.

summary: PASS with one Low, non-mandatory observation. D-042 closes F-DG0-169, now CLOSED_VERIFIED. checkClosure's anchor 1 is unconditional: a closure verified in a round whose source_commit does not resolve is rejected rather than skipped. My round-25 case closes with 0 errors at 2386a0f and is rejected at 7edacdc. The new unit test fails on the pre-D-042 code and passes on the candidate. No genuine closure regressed: 115/115 real closures have a present round source_commit and pass all three anchors, and the dry run shows 0 closure or anchor errors. There is no new gap: the surviving findManifest/D-035 tolerance still keeps a superseded round's manifest valid but can no longer carry a verification, and F-DG0-164/165/166/168/246/249 still hold. Node suites pass 102/102, Python 22/22, and the pre-freeze passes in a fresh --no-local clone. The sandbox, secrets, CI and determinism checks are unchanged and pass. Residuals 7 and 8 are exactly as disclosed. New: F-DG0-170 (Low, mandatory_violation false). The commitPresent() header comment at rules.mjs:603-605 still calls anchor 1 conditional, contradicting the D-042 code and its checkClosure comment; it affects documentation only. Note: review-common.md says 'Review round: 23', but its own header, the paths and stages.json all say round 26; I used 26.
